caseNameFull: Pohl v. Acheson, Secretary of State
attorneys: Warren E. Magee for petitioners. Solicitor General Perlman and Robert W. Ginnane for respondents.
judges: Application, Are, Black, Consideration, Granted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion certiorari should be granted. Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
